name: Gaussian Piling
definition: A rendering model for slice-based volumetric reconstruction that maintains Gaussian primitives' form through axial re-parameterization, opacity modulation, and additive rasterization to enforce 3D-to-2D consistency and prevent ghosting artifacts.
summary: Gaussian Piling is a slice-based volumetric reconstruction method that unifies 3D Gaussian Splatting with an imaging system-aware focus model to compress aggressively while preserving internal structure.
